create_model_report_visualizer: create a ModelReportVisualizer instance from generated quantization reports to visualize model statistics
get_all_unique_module_fqns: get all unique module fully qualified names from the quantization reports
get_all_unique_feature_names: get all unique feature names from quantization reports, optionally filtering to plottable tensor features only
generate_table_visualization: generate and print formatted tensor-level and channel-level tables from quantization reports with optional feature and module filters
generate_plot_visualization: generate a line plot of a single quantization feature across model modules with optional module filter
